entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Afonso Celso de Assis Figueiredo Júnior, titled Count of Afonso Celso by the Holy See, better known as Afonso Celso, was a Brazilian poet, professor, historian, and politician. He was one of the founders of the Brazilian Academy of Letters, where he occupied the chair number 36.
